doc: JARVIS judge registry — a new capability is a new decision function, never a new agent. Each judge: typed question, allowed outputs, proceed-threshold, escalation. publish/send/pay is never a judge question (GODMODE). Historical accuracy comes from judge.py calibrate().

lead_readiness.question: Given this lead's behaviour, which lane?
lead_readiness.notes: HOT skips the line (same-day reply drafted). WARM = follow up until yes/no. COLD = nurture. Re-judge on every reply.

reply_intent.question: What does this reply from a prospect mean?
reply_intent.on_review: route to Fable + the 30 Sep reply-handling cards (artifacts/2026-09-30)

content_scale.question: Based on attributed leads (never likes), what should happen to this asset?
content_scale.on_review: experiment ledger row; a confounded result cannot be promoted (LEARNING-LOOP A6)

search_intent.question: What is the intent behind this search query?
search_intent.on_review: keep as UNKNOWN in the keyword sheet

anomaly.question: Is this metric movement anomalous against its baseline window?
anomaly.on_review: Fable explains cause before any flag reaches the One Page

duplicate.question: Is this item substantively a duplicate of the given prior item?

human_review_required.question: Does this action or content need Bianno before proceeding, even though it is not publish/send/pay?
human_review_required.on_review: YES wins ties — when unsure, ask the human
human_review_required.notes: This judge can only ADD human review, never remove it. Publish/send/pay never reaches this judge — always human.

swipe_verdict.question: What should Jarvis do with this observed content pattern?
swipe_verdict.on_review: Fable decides; pattern evidence (frequency, sample) required, single viral posts are noise

message_route.question: What does Bianno want done with this WhatsApp message to his assistant?
message_route.notes: Lives inside jarvis/whatsapp/functions/jarvis-line/index.js. Blocked lane (<0.5) = CAPTURE only, never acts. Eval: whatsapp-003. This is Jev routing a MESSAGE to a lane — not Jev routing the Claude brain (still SKIP per two-speed.md).
